title: Name a type with a type alias
objective: Give an existing type a new name with a type alias, and use the name in a function.

body.text: A type called gives a type a name of its own. Here score is a number, so a function can say it takes a score and returns a score. The name is only a label: a score is still a number.

body.title: Add a bonus to a score
body.code:
a type called score is a number

function bonus
    takes score called s
    returns a score
    gives back s plus 10

make points equal to 20
make total equal to bonus(points)
say "{total}"

body.prompt: The program uses a type that was never named, so it does not compile. Make it print 15.
body.starter:
function bonus
    takes score called s
    returns a score
    gives back s plus 10

make points equal to 5
make total equal to bonus(points)
say "{total}"
body.solution:

function bonus
